phase_10.name: Launch Readiness — Critical Path
phase_10.objective: Eliminate all hard blockers preventing open beta launch. Fix security exposure, enable health integration, and implement retention mechanics.

deliverables.title: AI API Key Security Resolution
deliverables.description: Remove EXPO_PUBLIC_ AI keys from production builds. Either: (A) Build a minimal API proxy (Cloudflare Workers) that authenticates users and forwards AI requests, or (B) disable AI features in the production build config and ship without them.
deliverables.effort: Option A: 3-5 days. Option B: 1 day.

deliverables.title: Silent Error Elimination
deliverables.description: Replace all 20+ .catch(() => {}) blocks with .catch(e => logError(e, { context })). Keep fire-and-forget semantics but ensure every failure is logged to telemetry.

deliverables.title: Push Notification Scheduling
deliverables.description: Implement local notification scheduling using expo-notifications: (1) Daily workout reminder (configurable time), (2) Streak at risk (missed 1 day), (3) Trial countdown (days 10, 12, 13, 14), (4) Weekly progress summary. Store preferences in app_state.

deliverables.title: Health Connect Stabilization
deliverables.description: Debug Health Connect crashes in isolation. Wrap all HC calls in try/catch with graceful fallback. Enable ff_health_sync feature flag for beta testers. Test on multiple Android devices (Samsung, Pixel, Xiaomi).

deliverables.title: React Hooks Audit
deliverables.description: Audit all 58 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps violations. Categorize each as: (A) intentional (add eslint-disable with comment), (B) genuine bug (fix dependency array), (C) should be refactored (extract to useCallback/useMemo). Fix category B immediately.

deliverables.title: PostHog Session Replay Privacy Audit
deliverables.description: Configure session replay masking for health-dashboard, craft-my-body, and any screen displaying health metrics. Verify no encrypted data appears in replay recordings.

exit_criteria: Zero AI API keys in production JS bundle
Zero silent .catch(() => {}) blocks — all failures logged
Local notifications scheduling functional (verified on device)
Health Connect enabled behind feature flag, no crashes on supported devices
58 hooks audit complete, genuine bugs fixed

phase_11.name: Quality & Hardening
phase_11.objective: Raise test coverage, reduce tech debt, add security layers, and improve code quality to support sustainable development velocity.

deliverables.title: Test Coverage Push to 70%
deliverables.description: Write tests for: (1) subscription flow E2E (purchase → access → expiry → renewal), (2) database migration path v0→v20, (3) workout generation edge cases (empty exercises, max fatigue, all injuries), (4) backup/restore cycle, (5) encryption roundtrip (encrypt → decrypt → verify), (6) screen smoke tests for all 27 screens.

deliverables.title: Lint Warning Reduction (804 → <200)
deliverables.description: Systematic cleanup: (1) Remove 275 unused variables with automated tool, (2) Replace 237 console.log with safeWarn/__DEV__ guards, (3) Type 50+ explicit anys with proper interfaces. Target: 804 → <200.

deliverables.title: Root/Jailbreak Detection
deliverables.description: Add runtime integrity check for rooted/jailbroken devices. Warn users. Optionally restrict encrypted health features on compromised devices.

deliverables.title: Certificate Pinning
deliverables.description: Implement TLS certificate pinning for RevenueCat and AI provider endpoints. Use react-native-ssl-pinning or custom native module.

deliverables.title: Large File Decomposition
deliverables.description: Split: (1) schema.ts into per-version migration files, (2) service.ts into per-domain service modules, (3) fitquest.tsx into composable components + workout hook. Target: no file >800 lines.

deliverables.title: Remove Dead Dependencies
deliverables.description: Remove @apollo/client and any other unused production dependencies. Audit all 56 deps for actual usage.

deliverables.title: Bundle Size Monitoring
deliverables.description: Add bundle analysis to CI pipeline. Track JS bundle size per commit. Set size budget (e.g., <15MB JS bundle). Alert on regressions.

exit_criteria: Test coverage ≥70% for services, ≥50% for engines
Root detection active on production builds
Bundle size tracked in CI with regression alert

phase_12.name: Growth & Scale Infrastructure
phase_12.objective: Build the infrastructure needed for user growth: cross-device sync, retention loops, conversion optimization, and platform expansion.

deliverables.title: Lightweight Backend (Cloudflare Workers + D1)
deliverables.description: Deploy minimal backend: (1) User authentication endpoint, (2) Encrypted data sync (cross-device), (3) AI API proxy (eliminates client key exposure permanently), (4) Push notification targeting, (5) Remote config / feature flags. Tech: Cloudflare Workers (edge compute) + D1 (SQLite at edge) + R2 (blob storage for backups).

deliverables.title: Conversion Optimization
deliverables.description: Implement: (1) Paywall A/B testing via PostHog experiments, (2) Trial urgency notifications (countdown badge, in-app banners), (3) Win-back flow for churned subscribers (re-engagement email via backend), (4) Promotional offers via RevenueCat, (5) Review prompt at positive moments (workout complete, streak milestone).

deliverables.title: iOS Launch Preparation
deliverables.description: Full iOS build and test cycle: (1) EAS Build for iOS, (2) HealthKit integration testing, (3) Face ID testing, (4) App Store metadata and screenshots, (5) Privacy nutrition labels, (6) App Review submission.

deliverables.title: Social & Community Features
deliverables.description: Implement: (1) Workout sharing via deep links, (2) Community challenges (weekly step challenges, workout streaks), (3) Leaderboards (opt-in, privacy-preserving), (4) Friend system (via backend invites).

deliverables.title: Exercise Video/Animation Content
deliverables.description: Add visual exercise guidance: (1) 3D model or short video per exercise, (2) Streaming from CDN (not bundled), (3) Offline caching for premium users, (4) Fallback to text + audio for free tier.

exit_criteria: Backend deployed with auth + sync + AI proxy
Cross-device sync functional for premium users
iOS app submitted to App Store review
At least 1 A/B test running on paywall
Review prompt implemented and showing at positive moments

timeline_summary.production_launch_target: After Phase 10 completion (for Android controlled beta), full production after Phase 11

resource_requirements.phase_11: 1 senior engineer + 1 junior for test writing
resource_requirements.phase_12: 1 senior engineer (backend) + 1 mobile engineer + 1 designer (iOS assets)
